My highest priority is at x and z. Since I prefer w over z, and w is still an acceptable option, I want to ensure I'm considered for w *before* z, in case my priority at w is enough to get me in.

Because rejections don't eliminate options, I don't need to strategically misrepresent my preferences. I should stick to my true preferences, as a rejection simply means I'm considered for my next choice. Therefore, maintaining my order of y > w > z > x is the best strategy.
